user.title: Solar savings
user.description: Entities the calculation is based on. They can be changed later in Configure.

data.bateria_positiva_descarga: Battery power is positive when discharging
data.red_positiva_importa: Grid power is positive when importing

data_description.bateria_positiva_descarga: Untick it if your inverter reports discharge as negative.
data_description.red: In W or kW, measured at the grid connection point.
data_description.red_positiva_importa: Untick it if your meter reports import as negative.
data_description.precio_venta: €/kWh credited for each exported kWh, before taxes.
data_description.iva: In %. Applied to the surplus price (with Spanish net billing, VAT is also saved on it).
data_description.impuesto_electrico: In %. Applied to the surplus price, like VAT.
data_description.periodo: Punta/Llano/Valle (or P1/P2/P3) state. Only used to split the discharged kWh by period.
data_description.consumo: In W or kW: everything the house uses. Without it, solar panel savings are not calculated.

acumulados.title: Totals so far
acumulados.description: If you come from another setup (e.g. YAML templates), enter its totals here so you don't start from zero. If you had the integration and removed it, the form is pre-filled with what it had saved.
